1. nATa rAgaM
mAdhavO mAM pAtu matsyAvatAra
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) veda uddharaNam

2. SrI gauLa rAgaM
kUrma avatAra dhRta manthara
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) amRta manthana

3. SrI rAgaM
varAha rUpa dhara bhU dhAraNa
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) hiraNyAksha haraNam

4. Arabhi rAgaM
narasimha rUpa ugra
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) hiraNyakaSipu haraNam

5. varALi rAgaM
vAmana rUpa bali darpa
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) tri vikrama caraNam

6. kEdAra rAgaM
paraSurAma kshatriya
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) mada haraNam

7. vasanta rAgaM
raghu rAma dasharatha nandana
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) rAvaNa haraNam

8. suraTi rAgaM
balarAma hala dhara
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) pralamba haraNam

9. saurAshTra rAgaM
gOpAla kRshNa yadu kula
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) kaMsa haraNam

10. madhyamAvati rAgaM
kalki rUpa dhara ashva
(madhyama kAla sAhityam) mlEccha haraNam
